[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximum depth of a binary tree** [LC 104 · Maximum Depth of Binary Tree](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-depth-of-binary-tree/){difficulty="Easy"}

$\text{depth}(v) = 1 + \max(\text{depth}(\text{left}), \text{depth}(\text{right}))$ visits each node once: $O(n)$ time. The space is the recursion depth, which is the tree height $h$: $O(\log n)$ for a balanced tree but $O(n)$ for a path-shaped one.

[Solved in full in @sec-cx-p5-depth.]{.card-link}
